title: לוחמת הקרח
summary: הסטרימרית הופכת ללוחמת קרח עם גלימה מפוארת, נכנסת לפורטל קפוא ונלחמת במפלצות זאב אפלות לצד שועל שלג לבן.

phases.what: Right eye glows bright blue with frost spreading on half the face.
Stands up as a white and purple kimono with a fur collar and glowing chest crystal materializes.
Room freezes with icicles and ice pillars; she holds an ice parasol.
A glowing blue portal to a snowy mountain opens behind her; a giant dark wolf lunges.
Scene cuts to a snowy landscape with a white arctic fox and dark armored wolves.
She kneels in the snow beside the white fox, surrounded by giant wolves and ice crystals under a full moon.

remix.prompt: The person in the image is live-streaming at home and suddenly their left eye glows bright blue as frost spreads across half their face.
